trigger.Name: Music

local list = {"music01", "music02", "music03", "music04", "music05", "music06", "music07", "music08", "music09", "music10", "music11", "music12"} local music = list[random(12)]

trigger.Name: MusicTimer
trigger.script:
local time = GetVar("Track").AsInt
if GetVar("Track").AsInt > 0 then time = time - 1 SetVar("Track", time) else TActivate("Music") end

trigger.Name: Events
trigger.script:
local day = tonumber(strsub(os.date(), 4, 5)) local month = tonumber(strsub(os.date(), 1, 2))
if month == 12 or month == 1 or month == 2 then SEASON = "WINTER" if ReadValueUserInfo("Season") ~= "WINTER" then TActivate("WinterWeather") end end
if month == 3 or month == 4 or month == 5 then SEASON = "SPRING" if ReadValueUserInfo("Season") ~= "SPRING" then TActivate("SummerWeather") end end
if month == 6 or month == 7 or month == 8 then SEASON = "SUMMER" if ReadValueUserInfo("Season") ~= "SUMMER" then TActivate("SummerWeather") end end
if month == 9 or month == 10 or month == 11 then SEASON = "AUTUMN" if ReadValueUserInfo("Season") ~= "AUTUMN" then TActivate("SummerWeather") end end
EditUserInfo("Season", "Season: "..SEASON)
if month == 12 and day >= 25 or month == 1 and day >= 1 and 10 > day then EVENT = "NEW_YEAR" end
TActivate("WinterWeather") trigger:Deactivate()

for i = 189, 380 do local tree = getObj("Object"..i) if tree then local prot = tree:GetPropertyById(1).AsString local pos = tostring(tree:GetPosition()) local rot = tostring(tree:GetRotation()) local name = "" if prot == "Breakable_Listvenoe1" then name = "listvenoe1" end if prot == "Breakable_Listvenoe2" then name = "listvenoe2" end if prot == "Breakable_Listvenoe3" then name = "listvenoe3" end if prot == "Breakable_Dub1" then name = "dub1" end if prot == "Breakable_Dub2" then name = "dub2" end if prot == "Breakable_Dub3" then name = "dub3" end if prot == "Breakable_Elka1" then name = "elka1" end if prot == "Breakable_Elka2" then name = "elka2" end if prot == "Breakable_Elka3" then name = "elka3" end if prot == "Breakable_Sosna1" then name = "sosna1" end if prot == "Breakable_Sosna2" then name = "sosna2" end if prot == "Breakable_Sosna3" then name = "sosna3" end
LOG("CreateNewDummyObject('"..name.."', '"..tree:GetName().."', -1, -1, CVector"..pos..", Quaternion"..rot..")") end end trigger:Deactivate()
